input.quote: 7. LIMITATIONS OF LIABILITY; INDEMNIFICATION OF CONTRACTOR.
input.rationale: Section 7 is captioned "INDEMNIFICATION OF CONTRACTOR" but contains no indemnity language at all: 7(a)-(c) are only liability caps, damages exclusions and a fee waiver, and a full-document search for "indemn" returns nothing but that heading. The only IP hook is the non-infringement warranty in 5(c), which gives no defence or indemnity, and 7(a)'s exception points to Paragraph 9 (Independent Contractor), a dangling carve-out. With no Vendor IP indemnity this sits in walk-away territory, so we insert the fallback-level Contractor IP indemnity (usual Company modification/combination/specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace and refund remedies, 3x annual fees super-cap) and conform the 7(a) cap so it does not swallow the super-cap. We did not add a Company-side indemnity, as none exists today and adding one would only weaken us.

proposal.summary: Insert Contractor IP indemnity with standard exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual fees super-cap; conform the liability cap exception.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no Contractor indemnity at all, so we have added a Contractor IP infringement indemnity at our fallback position, with the usual Company modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual fees super-cap. We also conformed the Paragraph 7(a) liability cap so it does not swallow that super-cap.

ops.text: Contractor shall indemnify Company against any third-party claim alleging that the Services or Works infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right, except to the extent the claim arises from Company's modification of the Services or Works, Company's combination of the Services or Works with items not supplied by Contractor, or Contractor's compliance with Company's specifications. Contractor shall, at its option, procure for Company the right to continue using, modify, or replace the affected item, and if none of those remedies is reasonably available, Contractor shall refund the fees paid for the affected item. Contractor's aggregate liability under this Paragraph 7(d) shall not exceed three (3) times the annual fees paid to Contractor under this Agreement.

ops.oldText: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF
ops.newText: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 7(d) OR PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF

mappings.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
